module: Pause menu data provider for multiplayer game modes: list of modes (GamemodesTab component), configuration of a mode (GamemodeSetupView) and settings of the current mode (GamemodeSettingsView). If multiplayer is active, it adds the player list as a side panel via routeData_multiplayer.

getGamemodesData.desc: Returns the GamemodesTab main panel and, if context.isMultiplayerActive, the player list side panel.

getGamemodeSetupData.desc: Returns the configuration view of a mode (GamemodeSetupView, prop gamemodeName).

getGamemodeSettingsData.desc: Returns the settings view of the current mode (GamemodeSettingsView).
